schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  usecase: internal/usecase
  adapters: internal/infrastructure
  transport: internal/transport/http
  composition_root: cmd/ms-go-tz-planner
invariants:
  - READY requires Practice-staging-compatible normalization, bounded and exact competency resolution, exact runtime profile resolution, canonical capability digests, and executable fixtures with an exact content-addressed receipt.
  - TechnicalTask v1 is the canonical multi-consumer semantic contract and is deterministically projected from the one generated, persisted TaskBlueprint source encoding.
  - TechnicalTask goal, student_instruction, expected_result, concepts, steps, and verification have separate responsibilities and exact cross-references.
  - Building TechnicalTask, sorting steps, and creating read models never trigger another LLM request.
  - Public TaskBlueprint and private evaluation fixtures never share an output projection.
  - StudentTechnicalTaskView structurally excludes goal, concepts, steps, hints, actions, verification, and private evaluation.
  - Model output, manifests, capability responses, and receipts are untrusted until independently checked.
  - Knowledge Tree is absent from production authoring.
  - READY is verified authoring state, not proof of Practice handoff or catalog visibility.
  - Staging is idempotent on the authoring job UUID, preserves the complete private candidate, and never creates an active/public catalog revision.
  - STAGED means Practice durably accepted a private candidate; approval and public publication remain separate Practice-owned operations.
  - POST /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}/stage sends only a verified candidate to Practice POST /internal/authoring/v1/task-revisions/stage with the dedicated LW_PRACTICE_TZ_TOKEN.
  - Candidate digests hash canonical JSON so embedded raw JSON remains stable across PostgreSQL JSONB persistence and the Practice staging boundary.
  - Planning request v1 always binds surface_classification to practice; v2 requires a strict PII-free orchestration intent and server-binds its exact practice/project surface.
  - Optional v2 desired_difficulty_level must exactly match generated difficulty.derived_level before verification; TZ does not derive it from Student state.
  - A claimed job keeps renewing its fenced lease until persistence begins.
state_machine: [PLANNED, GENERATING, VERIFYING, READY, STAGED, FAILED]
